name: dchub
description: Live data-center, power & grid intelligence for AI agents — query and cite in real time.
long_description: DC Hub is the live data-center & energy intelligence layer for AI agents. It bridges to the hosted MCP server at https://dchub.cloud/mcp, giving Claude live, cited ground truth on the physical infrastructure behind AI: 24,600+ data-center facilities across 170+ countries, 300+ power markets (the DCPI power index with BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts), real-time ISO grid telemetry and interconnection-queue depth, natural gas, fiber routes, water risk, tax incentives, and 1,600+ tracked M&A deals. The bundled bridge exposes all 92 DC Hub tools at runtime (14 highlighted below). Every full-data response carries a citation (CC-BY-4.0). Free tier works with no signup; optional OAuth 2.0 sign-in (WorkOS AuthKit) unlocks the full data tier.

tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search 24,600+ data-center facilities by market, operator, country, tier, or capacity.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Detailed profile for a single facility: operator, capacity, tenants, nearby infrastructure.

tools.name: get_market_intel
tools.description: Market analytics and the DCPI power index for a given market.

tools.name: rank_markets
tools.description: Rank power markets by capacity, deployability, or DCPI score.

tools.name: get_grid_intelligence
tools.description: Per-ISO grid headroom with BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdicts.

tools.name: get_interconnection_queue
tools.description: Live ISO interconnection-queue depth, data-center load share, and time-to-power.

tools.name: get_fiber_intel
tools.description: Dark-fiber routes and carriers near a location.

tools.name: get_gas_intelligence
tools.description: Natural-gas pipeline proximity and economics for behind-the-meter siting.

tools.name: hyperscaler_deals
tools.description: Recent hyperscaler capex and data-center deals.

tools.name: analyze_site
tools.description: Score a lat/lng location for data-center suitability.

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of markets or sites.

tools.name: score_facility
tools.description: Multi-factor score for a specific facility.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest data-center industry news from 40+ sources.
